coupling_audit.advance_current_task_behavior: ignition/tools/advance_current_task.py::_contract_target always writes execution_status=IN_PROGRESS and terminal=false for the successor Current task
coupling_audit.lineage_schema_behavior: ignition/schemas/operations/current-task-lineage-status-r1.schema.json models task status and terminality but has no independent obligation registry or terminal-with-open-obligation status
coupling_audit.release_schema_behavior: ignition/schemas/operations/current-release-lifecycle-r1.schema.json couples phase validity to current_task_terminal and contains no obligation authority
coupling_audit.projection_behavior: generate_current_facts.py, build_current_snapshot.py, and current_surface_compiler.py mirror the task status, terminal flag, and live obligation in one Current projection without an independent lifecycle source
coupling_audit.missing_authority: No independent machine source owns formal task terminality separately from the open-obligation registry

finding.statement: Task141 Step00-16 and publication evidence establish formal completion, but Current remains IN_PROGRESS solely because the long-lived validated-completion obligation is open.
finding.required_correction: Introduce independent formal task lifecycle and open-obligation authorities, then render their linkage explicitly on Current surfaces.

safety_boundary.claim_ceiling: Repository-local baseline and lifecycle-coupling diagnosis only; no external-agent capability, safety, production, Owner, or epistemic acceptance claim.
